_readme: Calibration sets (COLLECTION.md §4). `membership` is PRO-30's trap set:
20 rows, key pre-registered 2026-08-29 before any judge verdict wrote,
each answer anchored to external documents (citation in the basis).
Gate: zero false members at high confidence. `stage` is the PRO-31
golden set, assembled before entry_stage publishes.
Honesty note: six keys (discord, eshares, pacaso, room-77, plus the
Haun/Kupor tenure facts) were web-anchored in-session before the blind
pass; the key is documents, not model opinion, which is what keeps the
test meaningful when one session writes and takes it.

skype: Debut deal: $65M from Fund I in the Silver Lake-led $2.7B eBay carve-out, Sep 2009; Microsoft $8.5B 2011 (techcrunch.com/2009/08/31/skype-sale-to-investor-group-led-by-andreessen-horowitz-confirmed, a16z.com/microsoft-buys-skype)
okta: 2010 Series A led, Ben Horowitz board seat; IPO 2017; a16z 13D/G + Section 16 filings on OKTA
github: Jul 2012 $100M Series A, sole investor, Peter Levine board (a16z announcement); Form D partner attribution 2012-2015
nicira-network-inc: a16z position from 2010; VMware acquired Nicira for $1.26B Jul 2012; Horowitz on Form D; Casado later a16z GP
maplebear-inc: Maplebear Inc. is Instacart's legal name; a16z led the $44M Series B Jun 2014, Jeff Jordan board; IPO 2023 as CART
mesosphere-inc: a16z led the $10.5M Series A Jun 2014, Peter Levine board (techcrunch coverage); later D2iQ
meteor-development-group-inc: a16z led the $11.2M Series A Jul 2012, Peter Levine board
eshares-inc: eShares Inc. is Carta's legal name; a16z led the $300M Series E at $1.7B May 2019, Marc Andreessen joined the board (techcrunch.com/2019/05/06/carta-was-just-valued-at-1-7-billion-by-andreessen-horowitz, carta.com/blog/seriese)
ning-inc: Andreessen co-founded Ning in 2004, five years before a16z existed; his officer/director Form D rows are personal; no a16z fund money (Ning raised from Legg Mason et al.)
3dna-corp: 3dna Corp. is Ning's corporate entity; same personal-founder class as ning-inc
acj-restaurant-group-llc: Jeff Jordan's personal restaurant investment vehicle; no venture operating company, no fund money
kyruus-inc: Julie Yoo co-founded Kyruus (2010) years before joining a16z (2019); Kyruus raised from Venrock/Highland/McKesson; her Form D rows are founder rows
pacaso-inc: Spencer Rascoff (a16z board partner) co-founded Pacaso; investors are SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Maveron, Greycroft, Crosscut, Fifth Wall - no a16z (geekwire.com 2021 round coverage)
room-77-inc: Rascoff personal angel/board seat; Room 77 raised from General Catalyst, Sutter Hill, Expedia (techcrunch.com/2013/01/03/room-77-funding)
avedro-inc: Brian Roberts homonym cluster: Avedro is an ophthalmic device company (OrbiMed/InterWest world, IPO 2019); no a16z involvement; the name-match is the issuer's own officer
ancestry-com-inc: Timothy Sullivan homonym: Ancestry's own CEO Tim Sullivan; Ancestry is Permira/Silver Lake territory; no a16z
discord-inc: Josh Elman's board seat at Discord was for Greylock (pre-a16z tenure); Discord's rounds 2018-2021 are Greenoaks/Tencent/Index/Dragoneer with no a16z, and Discord is on none of a16z's own lists
a-capital: A.Capital is Ronny Conway's venture fund; the investment-list entry is an LP/fund position, and a fund vehicle is not a venture-outcome operating company
meta4-capital: Meta4 Capital is an NFT fund a16z anchored as an LP (2021); fund vehicle, not an operating company, despite the site listing
blocktower-capital: BlockTower Capital is a crypto investment firm; a16z's exposure is a fund/LP position, not an operating-company investment
